sentences.text: Prima facie, I am of this opinion that the grounds raised by the petitioners should be agitated before the trial Court upon their appearance at the time of hearing on the question of charge.

Since the petitioners are residing at a far distant place and are octogenarian, therefore, they shall be exempted from personal appearance in the Court and only when it becomes imperative to ensure their presence, they shall not be summoned to appear.
They would appear before the trial court on or before 10.01.2025 and shall move a regular bail application under Section 437 of the Cr.P.C.
Upon moving the application, they shall be released on bail on the very same day on the amount of surety and bonds as the Court deems fit.

The ground of discharge as may be raised by the petitioners shall be considered objectively in light of the statutory provision as well as the judgment passed by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of M/S. Pepsi Foods Ltd. & Anr vs Special Judicial Magistrate & Ors decided on 04.11.1997 reported in AIR 1998 SUPREME COURT 128 whereafter a reasoned speaking order shall be passed which must reflect adjudication of the submissions made on behalf of the defence.
4. Accordingly, the instant misc petition is disposed of.
5. Stay petition also stands disposed of.
